original_target.title: Weak survival of the contact process on nonamenable Cayley graphs
original_target.area: Spatial epidemics and nonequilibrium phase transitions

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original every nonamenable Cayley graph for an arbitrary fixed finite symmetric generating set, strict global-versus-local survival gap. Lyons §8 proves it for regular trees and graphs with a quantitative expansion ratio, not all nonamenable Cayley graphs. Arbitrary nonregular tree counterexamples are not Cayley counterexamples, and critical extinction does not separate thresholds. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
